caption:
Today's Sky is Yin Wood, The Climbing Vine 🌿 Pause on your Day Master.

Your Day Master is the element of the day you were born. Today's element meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yin Wood gets a friend day, Yang Fire feels supported, Yin Earth feels the pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

Which line fits your Wednesday? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #astrology #zodiacsigns #personalgrowth #metaphysics #bazi #chinesemetaphysics #fiveelements #singapore
day_line: A climbing vine on a Pig day. Easy-going and friendly: good for small favours, easy to say yes to everything.

lines.Yang Wood: Someone copies your idea today. Take it as a compliment, then finish yours first.
lines.Yin Wood: Your people find you today. Say yes to the kopi; skip the gossip that comes with it.
lines.Yang Fire: Help turns up without asking today. Accept it, and say thank you out loud.
lines.Yin Fire: A quiet hunch is right today. Trust it, but double-check the meeting time.
lines.Yang Earth: The boss notices your work today. Keep the reply short and the tone kind.
lines.Yin Earth: Wednesday pushes a bit today. Do the hardest task before lunch, then breathe.
lines.Yang Metal: Good day to sort the bills. Cancel the app subscription you forgot about.
lines.Yin Metal: A side chance pops up today. Say maybe, read the fine print, then decide.
lines.Yang Water: You'll want to correct someone today. Pick one battle; let the rest go.
lines.Yin Water: Fun mood today. Share the meme, start the playlist, still hand in the work.
